# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.0.1

Version 1.0.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.0.0

- **The minimap stays put.** It no longer moves up or changes size to make room for the game's clock; it is always in
  the same place in the bottom left corner.
- **The clock is in the window's corner.** In windows wider than 4:3 (16:9 monitors, phones) the game's 2D picture is
  the 4:3 middle of the window, so the clock sat well inside the window's right edge. It now keeps the same distance
  from the window's edge as in a 4:3 window, in the bottom right corner.
- **The clock no longer moves into the minimap's corner.** While the player was in the bottom right of the screen, the
  clock moved to the bottom left. With the minimap on, it now hides for that moment instead and comes back on the
  right (with the minimap off, it moves left as before).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves and the Korean patch are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on Android,
  **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch: Install). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Running, default keys and switching to Korean are described in the
  [v1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.0.0) and the
  [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.0.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Automated input scripts, new game → town, on Linux 32/64-bit and Windows 64/32-bit (Wine): in a 1280×720 window
  the clock is in the window's bottom right corner and the minimap stays in its place in the bottom left; a 640×480
  window is as before; M and a click open and close the map. The Windows 64/32-bit builds give the same screens.
- With the bottom-right condition forced true in a test-only build: with the minimap on the clock stays hidden, with
  it off it moves left as before.
- The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.0.1, versionCode 10001). It was not
  run on a device.

## Known limitations

- The SD card, GBA link and Card e-Reader are treated as "no device".
- Not yet tested much on real Windows or Android devices.
- Villagers do not reply to letters with more than a few words of Korean (the same happens on a GameCube).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
